# CodeCraft: Galactic Developer

> Build a space colony by writing real HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

CodeCraft is an educational coding game. Learners write real front-end code in-browser and see it materialize as structures in a 3D space colony.

## Site

- Home (colony + challenges): https://codecraft-dev.vercel.app/
- Playground: https://codecraft-dev.vercel.app/playground
- Privacy: https://codecraft-dev.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms: https://codecraft-dev.vercel.app/terms
- Source: https://github.com/forbiddenlink/codecraft-dev

## Product facts

- Audience: beginners and intermediate web developers learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through gameplay
- Core loop: pick a challenge → write code in Monaco → check solution → unlock colony rewards
- Stack: Next.js App Router, React 19, Monaco, React Three Fiber, Redux Toolkit

## Optional docs for agents

- Environment template: /.env.example (repo)
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
